answer_1.quote: We propose ChatSOP, an SOP-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search planning framework designed to enhance the controllability of LLM-driven dialogue agents.

answer_2.quote: We measured the precision, recall, and F1 score of the dialogue paths... For dialogue generation, we measured the accuracy of single-turn dialogue actions (Acc T), controllable actions (Acc C), proactive actions (Acc P) and the accuracy of the entire dialogue (Acc D).
automatic_metrics: Accuracy (Acc T, Acc C, Acc P, Acc D)

answer_3.quote: L(d_t, a_t) function represents the logical rationality of the current action, as assessed by the LLMs. It is computed as the mean of several binary (0 or 1) evaluations derived from prompt-based sampling by the LLMs.

answer_4.quote: The evaluation was conducted by the same annotators previously described in §4.2... we conducted a human evaluation to measure the proportion of accurate control actions, proactive actions, and knowledge accuracy.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rated each generated turn for controllability accuracy, proactivity accuracy, knowledge accuracy, goal success rate, and logical coherence.
